goal: Package and validate the current WoW112 Android headless POC-05 with guarded mailbox actions, inventory/gold snapshot, reconnect resilience and one-run Windows/ADB delivery.
notes: POC-05 local gameplay evidence on 2026-10-04 reached SRP6 PASS, world auth PASS, SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD PASS and gold snapshot, but failed opening AH because discover_poc05_context collapsed multiple detected auctioneer GUIDs to one arbitrary HashSet candidate. This iteration preserves the candidate pool and retries unattempted auctioneers every 16 packets while continuing object-update discovery, matching the proven POC-02/04 strategy. Launcher defaults are play.octowow.st:3724 and realm index 1; world address is taken dynamically from the realm list. Gameplay result for this exact SHA remains pending user test.
